name: Kaiba's Collector Box
extDescription:
The Starter Deck: Kaiba Reloaded is a modern revamp of the original Dueling Legend’s Starter Deck; this 50-card Deck features Kaiba’s favorite cards, like Battle Ox, Vorse Raider, and Enemy Controller, and is tuned to provide a fun and entertaining experience for players of all skill levels. Fans can enhance their Starter Deck: Kaiba Reloaded further with the 3 booster packs of Duelist Pack: Kaiba and 3 booster packs of Duelist Pack: Yugi that are also included. Duelist Pack: Kaiba and Duelist Pack: Yugi have both been out of print for years, and contain highly sought-after cards like Chaos Emperor Dragon - Envoy of the End, Sorcerer of Dark Magic, Pot of Greed, and Crush Card Virus.

Unleash the raw power of your Deck just like Seto Kaiba and decimate your opponents with his Blue-Eyes White Dragon!

Each Kaiba’s Collector Box contains:
1 Starter Deck: Kaiba Reloaded
3 Duelist Pack: Kaiba booster packs
3 Duelist Pack: Yugi booster packs
1 Ultra Rare variant art Blue-Eyes White Dragon
1 variant art Oversized Blue-Eyes White Dragon Card
